description: Source-priority and matching rules used by tools/world/reality/conflate.py. Priorities are per attribute, not per dataset, and each carries the evidence that justifies it. Changing a rule changes the report, never silently the IDs (IDs come from the first geometry source, see docs).

footprint_priority.why: local authoritative footprint; not acquired (blocked), slot kept so the rule does not change when it arrives

hand-traced in Key West; measured against the 2019 lidar elevated-surface mask in Old Town it fits better than USA Structures (IoU 0.615 vs 0.559, reports/build_stats.json) and carries more detail (median 5 vs 4 vertices, mean 6.8 vs 6.1)
FEMA/ORNL USA Structures: federal, but in Key West the polygons are NGA 2008-lidar ML footprints marked 'Unverified' (val_method) - older epoch and rectilinear simplification
global ML footprints, lowest geometric fidelity

buildings.footprint_quality_check: Each candidate footprint gets lidar_support = share of footprint cells with nDSM > 2 m in the 2019 lidar. A lower-priority footprint replaces a higher one only if its support exceeds it by > 0.25 and the higher one is < 0.4 (evidence the higher-priority outline is misplaced); recorded as method=lidar_quality_override.

height_priority.why: 2016 measurement; agreement within max(1.0 m, 10 %) with 2019 upgrades to cross_verified

roads.geometry_source: overture_2026_09_23_1 (OpenStreetMap ways, split into Overture segments)
roads.width_inference_reason: Same class table the Stage 5 preview used (build_key_west_city_preview.py); marked inferred, confidence 0.35, and replaced whenever a width tag exists.

lidar.opening_reason: Morphological opening of the canopy mask with a 2.5 m square removes utility poles, wires, sign gantries and narrow hedges (measured on tile 424500e/2717500n: 3x3 (1.5 m) opening left crown peaks on the utility poles and wires along the streets). Trees with crowns narrower than 2.5 m are not detected.

trees.note: Lidar tree candidates are derived detections (canopy-height local maxima, not species). Continuous canopy larger than dense_canopy_area_m2 (mangrove stands, hammocks) is stored as a 'lidar_canopy_dense' area instead of invented individual trees. Absence of a candidate never means absence of a tree.
